text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
After training, I went out with Furioso to 
buy some missing supplies.

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text:
We got all the training supplies. Now 
tomorrow's training will—

text_block_list.name: Furioso
choice_data_list: Ah, that ad video from the train, huh.
Ah, that ad video from the train, huh.

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
Hello, everyone~! It's Hokko Tarumae, the 
local idol of Tomakomaiâ

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
I am Oguri Cap. I've come to bring event 
information about Tokyo Racecourse.

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
"We're holding an event at Tokyo 
Racecourse! It's called—"

text_block_list.name: Tarumae & Oguri
text_block_list.text:
"Let's have a race against us, who came 
from the regional circuits!"~!

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
It seems special local delicacies from 
Kasamatsu and Tomakomai are gathered here 
too. There are tons of gourmet dishes you 
can only eat here. Whoops... now I'm 
getting hungry.

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
Geez, Oguri-san! Anyway! We'll be waitin' 
for everyone~!

text_block_list.name: Passerby A
text_block_list.text:
Hokko Tarumae is so cute! She's always 
such a hard worker! You just can't help 
but root for her!

text_block_list.name: Passerby B
text_block_list.text:
Oguri Cap is a star back in my hometown. 
She runs so strong... Man, I just love 
her!

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text:
A fellow racer from the regional circuit 
is making waves. Seeing that, how could I 
not fire up?
choice_data_list: We can't afford to lose either, can we!
We're not gonna lose either, after all!

I understand how you feel, but I can't let 
you push yourself too hard.

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text:

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text:
Haa... haa... I'll hype up Funabashi 
too... just watch me.

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text:
...Understood. You're looking out for my 
well-being, aren't you?

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text:
It cannot be helped. If so! Then all we 
must do tomorrow is increase the quality 
of our training.
